$CUDA is a meme token launched against tokenized NVDA, not against a dead stable or a random coin. You buy $CUDA with the NVIDIA stock token. You sell $CUDA back into that same pair. The chart lives next to the stock the whole market already watches.
How the pair works
1.  Pick NVDA / NVDAx as the quote asset on vibe/vibe
2.  $CUDA prints on the bonding curve against that stock token
3.  Every buy and sell is priced in NVDA
4.  Fees / buyback / burn follow the pad rules for stock-paired launches
Why this launch is big
•  NVDA is the stock everyone already understands
•  Stock-paired memes are the new vibe/vibe lane (infra + stocks + memes)
•  One ticker people can scream: $CUDA
•  Green chip energy, Robinhood rails
What $CUDA is
A vibe/vibe project token paired with tokenized NVIDIA stock.
What $CUDA is not
Not NVIDIA stock.
Not a claim on NVIDIA Inc.
Not dividends. Not voting. Not official.
